full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media portrait shows a dark-skinned person in right-facing profile, with an urban skyline blended into the lower head and shoulders. Short natural hair forms a soft dark mass against a worn cream background. The face fills the upper right, its cheekbone, broad nose, lips, and strong jaw carefully modeled in black-brown and sepia. A focused eye looks beyond the frame; no visible smile interrupts the serious expression. The left side of the head fades into a tall orange-brown tower, whose horizontal bands and small windows appear through the portrait's shadow. Across the bottom, a dense array of low buildings, rooftops, and scattered high-rises extends from left to right. Their silhouettes climb into the neck and shoulder area, creating a double-exposure transition rather than a clean border. The city is warm with rust, ocher, and burnt orange, growing paler toward a hazy distant horizon. The background is parchment-like, with small scratches, stained patches, and irregular grain. Light comes from the right, sharpening the nose and lips and leaving the far side of the face in deep shadow; the city below glows with a different, low warm light. Crisp facial contours contrast with the broken, layered edges of the architecture. The composition balances a monumental close profile above a broad miniature city band. Its muted sepia palette and distressed surface give the image an archival, reflective feel.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介肖像呈现一位深色皮肤人物朝右的侧面，城市天际线融入头部下缘与肩部。短而自然卷曲的头发在磨旧的奶油色背景前形成柔暗团块。面部占上部右侧，颧骨、宽鼻、嘴唇和坚实下颌以黑褐和棕褐色认真塑形。目光望向画外，严肃表情没有笑意。头部左侧淡入一座橘褐色高楼，其水平楼层和小窗透过肖像阴影出现。画面下方，密集低楼、屋顶与零散高层从左向右铺开。建筑剪影爬进颈部和肩部，形成双重曝光式过渡，而非干净边界。城市呈铁锈红、赭色与焦橘色，朝朦胧远方地平线逐渐变浅。背景像旧羊皮纸，带小划痕、染色斑和不规则颗粒。光从右侧来，使鼻梁与唇缘清楚，脸的远侧落入深影；下方城市则受另一种低处暖光照亮。清楚的面部轮廓与建筑破碎叠层的边缘形成对照。构图在上方巨大的近景侧面和下方宽阔的微缩城市带之间取得平衡。低饱和棕褐配色与磨损表面赋予图像档案般的沉思气息。
style_prompt_en: A distressed mixed-media portrait surface blends a sharply modeled dark central silhouette into a dense lower band of warm geometric fragments. Black-brown and sepia tones carry the focal volume; rust, ocher, and burnt orange brighten the layered base. A tall repeated linear structure rises into one side of the silhouette, so two visual scales overlap without a hard dividing edge. Clean contours remain at the most prominent profile-like boundary, while the lower and rear edges dissolve into grain, stains, scratches, and smoky overlays. Directional side light lifts selected planes and leaves the opposite side nearly black; a second low warm glow spreads across the lower fragments. The background has an aged cream paper texture. Close scale above and intricate miniature repetition below create a deliberate double-exposure rhythm, giving depth through transparency, overlap, and tonal contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 磨损感混合媒介肖像表面把塑形清楚的深色中央剪影融入下方密集的暖色几何碎片带。黑褐和棕褐色构成焦点体量；铁锈红、赭色与焦橘提亮层叠底部。一处重复线性结构从剪影一侧向上伸起，让两种视觉尺度在没有硬分界线的情况下重合。最突出的侧向边界保持干净轮廓，下方与后侧边缘则溶进颗粒、污斑、划痕和烟雾状叠影。定向侧光提起选定平面，让相对一侧接近黑色；第二层低处暖光铺过下方碎形。背景有旧奶油色纸张肌理。上方近景尺度与下方细密微缩重复形成有意的双重曝光节奏，通过透明感、遮叠与明暗对比建立深度。
theme_en: A side-profile portrait merged with a warm city skyline
theme_zh: 与暖色城市天际线融合的侧面肖像
name: City of God
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
